name: agent-dispatch-codex
description: Codex-native role-aware task routing with task-selected writer models, automatic hooks, and serial primary-agent Git.

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks by role while choosing writer models per task.
interface.longDescription: Automatically injects Codex-native routing guidance and generates project-local custom agents after installation. Keeps trivial work in the primary agent, preserves specialized search, planning, and review roles, and lets the primary agent select writable roles, models, and reasoning strength from task complexity, context, risk, availability, and explicit user preference. Keeps pure Git CLI operations serial in the primary agent, limits concurrent subagents, and tells the coordinator to close agents as soon as their work is integrated.
defaultPrompt: Show the effective Agent Dispatch policy for this project.
Configure which commands Agent Dispatch treats as lightweight.
Explain role-aware task routing and dynamic writer model selection.
Configure models for Agent Dispatch planning, search, worker, and reviewer roles.
Explain the primary-agent-only serial Git policy.
